shared_elements: schematic profile animal/creature forms with curved snouts or heads
linear carved figural scene on a stone surface
repeated small vertical strokes/hatched elements along a line
justification: Both surfaces show schematic, outline-carved figural motifs including profile animal-like heads with upcurved snouts, and both use rows of short repeated strokes along a line (crew strokes in A, border ticks and hatching in B). Otherwise the content diverges sharply: A is dominated by overlapping crewed boats with high curled prows arranged horizontally, while B is a vertically stacked two-register composition with human figures, quadrupeds under an arch and dense ribbon interlace, none of which appears in A.
